context.person: A person using a visa application portal
context.user_goal: Upload a complete passport image, then review and submit the application separately.

product_state.preceding_state: A passport scan was rejected because the machine-readable zone is cropped.
product_state.current_state: The application remains a draft. The uploaded image was not accepted.
known_facts: The uploaded image was not accepted.
All four passport edges and the machine-readable zone must be visible.
Uploading a replacement does not submit the application.
forbidden_claims: A new upload submits the application.

challenge: Rewrite the inline error and recovery control so the person can understand travel document upload rejected, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: Open the file picker to upload a replacement image.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Return to the draft without uploading now.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The application cannot be submitted with the cropped image.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Upload a complete passport image, then review and submit the application separately.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
